business_summary.text: Anant Raj Limited is a Delhi-NCR real estate developer with residential townships, commercial leasing and hospitality, and is building a data centre and cloud services business through Anant Raj Cloud Pvt Ltd (Ashok Cloud).

call_points.text: 25% of the 357 MW IT load capacity will be used for cloud services, subject to market demand.
Data centre, infrastructure and allied services revenue was ₹90 Cr in Q1FY27.
EBITDA margin rose 449 bps YoY to 31.15%, with EBITDA including other income.
Infomerics upgraded the company's rating to 'A- Stable' outlook.
GH 3 licence over 6.38 acres with about 1.20 msf saleable area is in advanced stage.
The board approved a demerger into Ashok Cloud Pvt Ltd, with 1 Ashok Cloud share for every 1 Anant Raj share on the record date.
The company was net debt-free as on March 31, 2026.
Anant Raj Cloud Singapore Pte Ltd was commissioned to source clients from South East Asia and the rest of the world.
25% of the 357 MW IT load capacity will be used for cloud services.
Empanelment with MeitY as a sovereign cloud provider and with BSNL as a data centre provider opens public-sector work.
Group Housing 3 (1.20 msf) is estimated at ₹2,886 Cr revenue, with its licence in advanced stage.
Phase IV of Anant Raj Estate adds 6.075 acres with potential of ~5 lakh sq ft; Phase V approvals are expected in Q2FY27.
Infomerics upgraded the long-term rating to IVR A-/Stable and the short-term rating to IVR A2+.
FY26 EBITDA margin was 28.04%, up 271 bps, with EBITDA including other income.
The company holds 83.43 acres of fully paid freehold land in Delhi NCR.
